assumptions: Sleep logged: 22:50-06:25, ~7.58h — squarely in the 7-9h target band, one continuous stretch.

08:00 Legendary Foods Protein Donuts, Cinnamon Crumble — assumed 2 donuts (product's own default serving size) since no count was given. Web-search reference (myfooddata): 80kcal/10g protein/13g carb/4g fiber/3g fat per donut, doubled for 2. High-fiber, low-sugar keto-style protein donut.

Lunch (time approximated at 13:00): 160g cooked spelt pasta (generic whole-grain spelt reference, ~127kcal/100g) + 220g beef bolognese sauce (standard homemade ground-beef/tomato/onion/carrot reference, ~150kcal/100g). Beef contributed the day's first zinc/selenium, tomato base gave some lycopene/vitamin C/folate — estimates, not weighed by ingredient.
14:45 dark chocolate cube (~5g), standard 70% dark chocolate reference — no meaningful micros in the tracked priority list.
14:40 double espresso (~60-80ml, counts as 2 caffeine shots) and 17:00 double espresso (same).

Dinner (time approximated at 19:30): 2 Agami Pita Pro spelt pitas + 4 Tnuva Emek Light yellow cheese slices (both verified references) + 2 sunny side up eggs + 2 spoons garlic Simfonia 5% cheese spread (same macro reference as plain Simfonia) + 30 cherry tomatoes (~510g, doubled the usual 15-tomato reference). Tomatoes drove another round of lycopene/vitamin C/folate.
18:45 omega-3 fish oil (2 softgels, ~1000mg EPA/DHA) — zero kcal/macros, brings the day's omega-3 micro to target.
